title: 检查三个参与入口与首页导航
result: 一份失效或不清楚的链接清单，以及对应修改建议。
scope: 从组织首页分别走到参与、需求和资源入口；记录哪里不知道下一步。

en.title: Check the three participation routes and homepage navigation
en.result: A list of broken or unclear links with proposed fixes.
en.scope: Follow the contribution, needs, and support routes from the organization homepage. Record where the next step is unclear.

title: 把参与指南读一遍，补齐新人会问的问题
result: 一版更容易照做的参与说明，附修改理由。
scope: 用第一次来社区的视角检查称呼、步骤和资料；保留不同专业的参与方法。

en.title: Improve the participation guide from a newcomer’s perspective
en.result: Clearer participation instructions with reasons for the changes.
en.scope: Check terminology, steps, and references as a first-time visitor. Preserve routes for different professional backgrounds.

title: 为历史黑客松手册整理一页索引
result: 按准备、开展、后续整理分组的原件链接。
scope: 复用既有 SOP；记录资料适用场景与待确认处，不复制整套手册。

en.title: Create a one-page index of past hackathon handbooks
en.result: Links to original materials grouped by preparation, delivery, and follow-up.
en.scope: Reuse the existing SOP, describe when materials apply, and flag uncertainties. Do not duplicate the whole handbook.

title: 试填需求模板，检查是否容易理解
result: 一次使用虚构情境的试填记录和字段改进建议。
scope: 检查哪些问题难以回答、哪些信息不适合公开；不使用真实患者资料。

en.title: Try the needs template and check whether it is easy to use
en.result: A trial using a fictional situation and suggestions for the fields.
en.scope: Check which questions are difficult and which information should not be public. Do not use real patient data.

title: 整理社区常见问题的第一版
result: 按参与、协作和贡献认可分类的简短问答。
scope: 优先整理现有说明已能回答的问题；未知事实标为待确认，不编造联系人。

en.title: Prepare the first community FAQ
en.result: Short questions and answers about participation, collaboration, and recognition.
en.scope: Start with questions the existing guides can answer. Flag unknown facts and do not invent contact people.

title: 设计资源信息核验与更新的方法
result: 一份资源条目示例和核验检查清单。
scope: 明确提供条件、有效期与兑现记录；示例与已确认资源分开。

en.title: Define how to verify and update resource information
en.result: An example resource record and a verification checklist.
en.scope: Clarify conditions, expiry, and delivery records. Keep examples separate from confirmed resources.
